text:
Alex: Morning — quick coverage swap. I'm off at 10:30 PT, handing to Matt. Quick notes: avoid deploys 10:45–12:15 PT (scheduled sim). Watchlist: embedding-queue spikes (>40), canary group B v2.1 latency, worker 5xx rate. runbook: https://redwood.example/runbooks/embedding-queue ; dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example/boards/embeds :white_check_mark:

Matt: @Alex got it. I'll take over at 10:30. Will mute noisy alerts and keep the sim window clear. If anything looks off I'll notify infra and Sophie. :eyes:

Sophie: Noted. I bumped batching target for the sim from 32 -> 24 to reduce cold-start pressure. Expect unit-cost to inch up during the run. I'll be available through the sim window.

Rao: FYI I ran a small KV cache eviction at 07:30 PT which may increase cold starts for short jobs. Watch tail latency for seq < 64.

Liam: Also FYI I lowered async-worker group burst to 60r/s for safe headroom. If we need throughput we can lift it after we validate.

Alex: One more: please don't ship hotfixes during the sim unless a pager goes off. If you must, leave an "ops-hold" label on the PR and ping the oncall rom. I'll also leave a short note in the handoff doc.

OncallBot: Scheduled simulation alert: load-sim starting 2026-03-18T11:00:00Z (20m). Will post start/stop updates.

Matt: Quick check: how do I query embedding queue size from CLI if dashboard lags?

Sophie: Use this quick command:
```
curl -s "https://internal.redwood/api/metrics?name=embed_queue_length&env=prod" | jq '.value'
```
Or open Dashboard -> Embedding -> Queue length.

Rao: If queue > 60 for > 2m, escalate to #infra and ping me (Rao).

Liam: If worker 5xx rate spikes for >3m, flip throttles to 30r/s and file a debug ticket with logs. Use tag `sim-2026-03-18` on the ticket.

Alex: Short watchlist for the handoff so it's easy to scan:
- Embedding queue length (thresholds 20/40/60)
- Canary p50/p95 latency (group B v2.1)
- Worker 5xx rate and error types
- Unit-cost per 1k tokens during sim

Sophie: Added the watch queries to my dashboard and pinned the runbook. Will post screenshots if anything drifts. :camera:

Matt: Taking over now. I'll ping here for any ops action and update the handoff doc: https://docs.redwood/example/handoffs/2368401234 . Please DM if you need me to stay later. Thanks all. :v:
